verdict.rationale: The pack documents a REST API with listed endpoints, a Python SDK and an MCP server, but nothing describes an interactive API reference or try-it console. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The 'runnable script' gallery covers community automations, which is an adjacent feature rather than runnable examples inside an API reference, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
